connections.description: External connections, one values layer per projects/<project>/connections/<name>.yaml.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

rootAccessKey.title: Root access key
rootAccessKey.description: Access key of the root (admin) identity.

rootSecretKey.title: Root secret key
rootSecretKey.description: Secret key of the root identity, 8 to 40 characters. Leave empty to have it generated in the cluster (Secret <release>-root, key RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY): a value set here is stored in Git.

consoleHost.title: Console host
consoleHost.description: Host name of the console, the ingress suffix is appended. Default: <instance>-<namespace>, the instance being the release name without its <namespace>- prefix.

apiHost.title: S3 API host
apiHost.description: Host name of the S3 API, the ingress suffix is appended. Default: <instance>-<namespace>-api.

caBundleSecret.title: CA bundle Secret
caBundleSecret.description: Secret holding ca.crt, trusted by the server when it calls the OIDC issuer.

memoryGi.title: Memory limit (GiB)
memoryGi.description: Memory limit of the server container. The upstream chart ships with no cap at all by default.

cpu.title: CPU request (vCPU)
cpu.description: CPU request for the server container. The limit is set to twice this value.

grants.title: Grants
grants.description: S3 identities of the store, one entry per principal. actions are neutral verbs scoped to buckets; sts marks a principal that needs full admin rights.

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: Principal name (letters, digits, underscore): names its policy okdp-<principal> and its environment variables.

credentialsSecret.title: Credentials Secret
credentialsSecret.description: Secret of the namespace holding the identity's keys.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Neutral verbs: read, list, write, admin (case-insensitive).

buckets.title: Buckets
buckets.description: Buckets the actions apply to. Empty: every bucket.

buckets.title: Buckets
buckets.description: Buckets created at startup. paths seeds prefixes inside the bucket for consumers that require them to exist beforehand.

oidcPolicies.title: OIDC policies
oidcPolicies.description: Policies named after the values of the OIDC policy claim.

name.title: Name
name.description: A value of the policy claim.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Neutral verbs: read, list, write, admin (case-insensitive).

buckets.title: Buckets
buckets.description: Buckets the actions apply to. Empty: every bucket.

oidcPolicyClaim.title: OIDC policy claim
oidcPolicyClaim.description: Claim carrying the policy names. Every one of its values must name an existing policy or the login is refused, so point it at a claim built for that purpose rather than at one carrying application roles.

oidcPolicyScope.title: OIDC policy scope
oidcPolicyScope.description: Client scope requested so the policy claim is issued. Read only when oidc.clientProvisioning is dcr.

outputSecretRef.title: Published credentials Secret
outputSecretRef.description: secretRef of the published s3 connection: an identity of this store (the credentialsSecret of a grant), e.g. one replicated to every namespace. Empty: <release>-s3-credentials, generated by ESO and granted read, list and write on every bucket.
